variants.V1: local controlled lowering: removable radial rail on two independent hard points (deck-wall bracket + a tie to the forward bulkhead or the outboard side wall, placed where clearest), trolley and manual descender; the litter runs out of the hatch under the rail, then is lowered vertically onto the couch
variants.V2: restrained platform: strapped incline board hinged at the hatch lip; the litter slides out of the hatch onto it and is belayed down and along onto the couch; the board is removed after the transfer
variants.V3: rated assist: wall jib on a bracket (deck wall or overhead wall, between the burn couches) with a rated hoist and manual lowering; once the litter is out of the hatch the jib carries it (order chosen per couch: shift then lower, or lower then shift) and sets it down; the boom is removed after the set-down

racks.slide: lateral drawer: the moved section runs outboard on floor runners (parallel to the split plane) until its back is at the outboard wall allowance; slides back afterwards
racks.trays: removable tray modules: the crop modules of the moved section (Crop_0 and each tray with its crop) are pulled out through the aisle face and stacked in a stowage column against the outboard wall in the Mess bay; the frame (base reservoir, back, lid, ends) stays in place; modules return afterwards
